topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
## Release snapshot

Promotes immutable `develop` snapshot `35bb14be4e2389b40648fae724a1333641725d9e` to `main`. The merge tree against current main is conflict-free.

This includes the production voice recovery merged in #26593:

- immediate Twilio media stream with no blocking prerecorded `<Say>`
- first-contact / returning-caller Cartesia opener and first-turn timing receipts
- production Worker direct Redis cutover to the environment-local REST adapter
- reproducible Railway adapter definition and transport regression test

## Voice acceptance already observed

- Railway adapter authenticated PING: PONG
- production `GET /api/auth/siwe/nonce`: HTTP 200 after cutover
- focused voice/runtime/persona tests: 110 pass
- cloud API/shared typechecks pass
- production Worker dry-run passes with `DIRECT_REDIS_BACKEND=redis-rest`
- cloud infra tests: 93 pass

## Gate note

The root `bun run verify` on this exact develop snapshot is blocked by pre-existing Biome formatting failures in `packages/shared/src/dev-settings-banner-style.test.ts` and `packages/shared/src/utils/safe-diagnostic-error.test.ts`; neither is part of #26593. Hosted exact-head checks remain authoritative for promotion.
